title: The Watcher in the Desert
description: A lone figure in a flowing blue robe and single large eye for a head stands on a winding black road in an orange desert. Above, a massive cracked red eye containing a swirling galaxy dominates a surreal cosmic sky filled with colorful smoke trails, floating faces, an egg-shaped planet, spheres, and abstract symbols.
prompt: A surreal desert scene with orange sand dunes and a winding black road. In the foreground, a mysterious robed figure in deep blue with a single large white eye for a head stands facing forward. The sky is a vibrant cosmic dreamscape dominated by a giant cracked red eye containing a swirling green and blue galaxy. Colorful smoke trails in purple, green and blue flow across the sky containing floating abstract symbols, human faces, a large white egg, and various colored spheres. A yellow road sign reading 'NO PASSAGE' is visible on the right.
